title: Maxey learns violin then guitar
summary: Maxey describes his first instrument, learning violin from a visitor, starting his own outfit in 1934 and taking up guitar in 1938.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Say what was your first instrument that you ever played?

First instrument I ever played? Mm-hmm. When I was seven years old. And there was a guitar line on the bed and I'd been here to play it. And I had it in my mind that I could play that. So I'd watch my brother where he placed his hand. And I went one day and I picked it up. And I tried it. And I made the same run he made and it scared me. I threw it out and I wouldn't try it anymore. So I watched the violin all the time. So I decided I wanted to play it. And I had it in my mind. And I was gonna come to play a violin. So I went head on and kept trying, kept trying. Got my fellow from D-Queen Arkansas dear. Stayed with us I remember for four months and he was a violin player. So I thought he'd teach me a little and I'd watch him. play here. The year of 1932, I made it up my mind that I was gonna come to play a violin. So I went head on, kept trying, kept trying. Come a fellow from D. Queen, Arkansas there. Stayed with us, I reckon, about four months, and he was a violin player. So I started to teach me a little and I'd watch him. So I got started on my own then. So in the year of 1934, I started out with my own outfit. So I believe I'm able to go for myself. Tune in the violin with the guitar. It called me a lot, a little note on the guitar, you know.
